ourKits.combo: Judgement of the Heavens to tether, Surge of the Heavens into the Blade to knock up and stun, Light of the Heavens for true damage at the Blade, Fury of the Heavens to teleport and slow.
ourKits.winCondition: Tether a target with the Blade, knock them up by dashing into it, and brawl with Energized basics that cut his cooldowns.
ourKits.passive: Strike of the Heavens Energizes his basics after ability hits, adding attack speed, lightning damage and cooldown reduction.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage while he tethers and knocks up.
ourKits.playAgainst: Watch where the Blade lands: it tethers, Surge into it knocks up, and Fury teleports him to it. Move away from the Blade and fight after Surge is used.

ourKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
ourKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

ourKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
ourKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
ourKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull enemies together, Dread Nova stuns the group, Particle Shredder homes in, then Synaptic Obliterator beams finish low targets
ourKits.winCondition: poke from long range, zone with Ether Crystal and land Dread Nova stuns into Obliterator beams
ourKits.passive: abilities apply Disintegration stacks that make further ability hits deal more damage
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect him while he channels Synaptic Obliterator
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova, his only stun; dive him during the Synaptic Obliterator channel when he is immobile, and keep health high since beams hit harder on missing health; magic armor blunts his damage

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol marks and tracks a hero, Chrono Swipe dashes in to consume the Mark for a slow and a Canister, Primeval Roar gives damage reduction then fears, and Ursine Burst grabs and slams the target
enemyKits.winCondition: track a target out of position, then grab and slam them for the kill
enemyKits.passive: every second basic attack grants Canisters for attack speed and on-hit healing; at max Canisters his Tesseract Core zaps and heals
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on the hero he grabs
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ursine Burst hovers briefly before the dash, so sidestep it or stay behind your frontline; back off from Primeval Roar until it explodes to avoid the fear; fight after Detection Protocol is spent; anti-heal trims his Canister healing

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
enemyKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
enemyKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
enemyKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Cast basic abilities to build 3 Thread, then Overclock Data Burst to slow and Mesmerize, follow with L.I.N.X true damage and an Erase Vector dash into the exploding Jolt; Final Thread Overclocks everything and its recast bomb finishes low targets.
enemyKits.winCondition: Chunk enemies with Overclocked abilities in lane and teamfights, then use Final Thread to chain several Overclocked casts and execute with the bomb.
enemyKits.passive: Neural Network: every 3 basic ability casts Overclock her next basic ability for an extra effect.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners or engage supports who keep enemies in Data Burst range and give her time to cycle Thread.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch her Thread count and respect the next ability when she is at 3, since Overclocked Data Burst Mesmerizes. Dodge the lobbed Data Burst before it detonates, and engage after Erase Vector is spent, which is her only dash. Magic armor helps but L.I.N.X return and pulse are true damage.

enemyKits.combo: Imperial Lash roots and dashes her to the furthest hero hit, Royal Flourish spins to Mesmerize, then Queen's Garden leaps in to root and drop a slowing Thornbush, with Iron Rose cast mid-combo for damage reduction
enemyKits.winCondition: start fights with Lash or Queen's Garden and keep enemies stuck in the Thornbush while her Thorns make allies hit harder
enemyKits.passive: damaging enemy heroes applies Thorns, and allies deal bonus true damage to Thorned enemies
enemyKits.playWith: damage dealers who follow her engage and profit from Thorns bonus true damage
enemyKits.playAgainst: sidestep Imperial Lash, since without it she has to walk in; once Queen's Garden is down she has no big lockdown, and walking out of the Thornbush limits its damage and slow; tenacity helps against her chained root and Mesmerize

members.name: Tainted Rounds

Hard CC: Primeval Roar (fear), Ursine Burst (pull).
Mobility: Chrono Swipe, Ursine Burst.
Self-healing in the kit (Tesseract Device).

Play against: Ursine Burst hovers briefly before the dash, so sidestep it or stay behind your frontline; back off from Primeval Roar until it explodes to avoid the fear; fight after Detection Protocol is spent; anti-heal trims his Canister healing

gameFlags.summary: Murdock kept dying to Sparrow (3 of 5)
evidence: Murdock died 3 of 5 times to Sparrow.

Play against Sparrow: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health
Item answer: Physical armor.

bullets: Each basic attack fired Sky Splitter's current-health damage and Tainted Rounds' healing cut, while Draconum's stacking bonus healing boosted Tesseract Device's healing on-hit.
Weald fired true-damage missiles when Boris damaged a hero under 30% health (10s cooldown per hero); Apex Hunter made Chrono Swipe hit harder below 20% max health.
Dryad's Boon trimmed basic ability cooldowns with every basic attack, bringing Chrono Swipe and Primeval Roar back sooner; Wind-Rider added attack speed briefly after each Chrono Swipe dash.
Savage Strikes healed Sparrow for the on-hit damage dealt, which grew against heroes; Ferocity added attack speed each second of hero combat, so more hits and more healing.
Thraex marked the last hero Sparrow basic attacked, raising Sparrow's damage on that hero and cutting that hero's damage to Sparrow, suiting long Heightened Senses duels.
Sun Shards bounced basic attacks onto more enemies, applying on-hit effects at 35% effectiveness, while each main hit fed Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter and Tainted Rounds.
